title: App crashes on login
body: If the app crashes during login, clear cache, update to latest version, and try again. If issue persists, collect device logs and escalate.

title: Payment sync error
body: Payment sync errors usually resolve within 15 minutes. Ask user to pull-to-refresh on the transactions screen. If unresolved after 30 minutes, escalate to engineering.

title: Refund policy
body: Refunds under $50 can be issued by the agent. Refunds $50 and above require manager approval before processing.

title: Duplicate charge
body: Duplicate charges are reversed automatically within 3 business days. If not reversed, issue refund after verifying the duplicate order ID.
